## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Modern scholars and psychologists have frequently compared this progression to cognitive therapy and the restructuring of automatic negative thoughts [Nauriyal 2006; Segall 2003; Symposium 2010].
DharmaNexus confirms substantial Pali-internal text reuse, notably with MN 119 (179 matches) and the *Mahāsaccaka Sutta* (MN 36), as well as textual alignments with the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99) and Tibetan canonical texts such as the *Mahāśūnyatā-sūtra* (D 291) and the *Yogācārabhūmi* (D 4039) [DharmaNexus].
